summary: Puts text on the clipboard and says so in place: the icon turns to a check and the word rolls to "Copied".

props.name: value
props.description: The text a press puts on the clipboard.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: What the button says, and its name to screen readers when `iconOnly`.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: What the button says once the text is on the clipboard.

props.name: failedLabel
props.description: What the button says when the browser will not copy.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Draws the icon alone, keeping `copyLabel` as the accessible name.

props.name: field
props.description: Shows `value` in a sunk field with the button at its end. When the browser will not copy, the text is selected, so the keyboard can.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with `value` once it is on the clipboard.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks copying and dims the button.

props.name: animated
props.description: The icon crossing over, the word rolling and a shake on a refusal. Reduced motion turns them off.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
